[LSER.7.7.2] Resolution rules:

- Zero matches → compile error: `no schema declares slot
  <name>`. Declared series must reach a real slot.
- Exactly one match → unqualified form binds to that schema.
- Two or more matches → compile error: `ambiguous; qualify as
  <Schema1>.<slot> or <Schema2>.<slot>`. The author picks one
  (or splits into multiple declarations).
